visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl with dark hair tied in pigtails and a white sleeveless dress featuring red strawberry patterns sits inside a gray folding wagon. A woman's hand gently pinches her cheek while she looks off-camera with a neutral expression. The setting appears to be a bright indoor entrance area with people walking in the background. (2) The scene shifts to a wide-angle view of a large indoor facility with light green flooring. Numerous families and visitors are seen walking through the space, which is decorated with hanging plants and various animal-themed stalls. Red velvet stanchions guide the crowd flow. (3) The camera zooms in on a sign depicting guinea pigs on the floor. Below, several guinea pigs of varying colors are seen scurrying around on a geometric wooden platform. The girl looks down with interest, leaning her hands on the edge of the enclosure while watching the animals move. (4) The toddler is seen walking through the facility, being led by her mother. They approach a rock-walled enclosure where a small chinchilla is peeking out from a circular hole. The girl's facial expression changes from curiosity to slight apprehension as she watches the animal shift positions. (5) In a bird enclosure with bark-covered walls, several bright yellow and green sun conures and red eclectus parrots are perched on wooden logs and feeding bowls. The girl is held in her mother's arms, looking warily at the birds. The mother has a parrot perched on her head, which makes the girl cry and whine with fear. (6) The family moves to an open feeding area with a sand-covered floor. The toddler is shown attempting to feed a Patagonia mara with a piece of lettuce, guided by her father's hand. Later, a large tortoise slowly crawls toward her, causing her to step back and reach for her father's hand while making distressed crying sounds. (7) The video concludes with a pink background featuring a cartoon illustration of a girl holding a strawberry, with brand text appearing below the graphic.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a conversational tone as an adult female voice asks a toddler 'Where is this?' in Mandarin. The toddler responds in a soft, high-pitched voice. There is no background music, only the low-frequency hum of an indoor crowd murmur. (2) As the scene transitions, rhythmic footsteps on a hard floor are audible, mixed with faint scuffling sounds of small animals moving. The mother's voice remains dominant, narrating with high pitch variability and a friendly, inquisitive tone. (3) Upon entering a bird enclosure, the acoustic texture shifts with high-frequency, sharp squawks and chirps from multiple parrots. The toddler's vocalizations change from calm speech to high-arousal whimpering and distressed crying. (4) A woman laughs, her voice resonant and joyful, which contrasts with the girl's sharp, high-intensity wails. The sound of wings flapping near the microphone provides a quick broadband transient event. (5) In the feeding area, the sound of trickling water from a nearby faucet is heard alongside the clinking of metal tongs. The toddler's voice exhibits high arousal as she shouts 'No more!' and 'Hug!', indicating significant emotional intensity. (6) The video concludes with a short, upbeat 2-second synthesized jingle that is melodic and bright, accompanying the appearance of the outro animation graphic.
